verifications.claim: The Artemis II splashdown is scheduled for April 10, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "April 10, 2026" (R2, R6); "Friday, April 10, 2026" (multiple); launch April 1 implies April 10 Friday (R1)
verifications.reasoning: All references confirm the splashdown occurred/scheduled on April 10, 2026.

verifications.claim: Live coverage of the Artemis II splashdown starts at 6:30 p.m. EDT.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "starting at 6:30 p.m." (R4); "starting at 6:30 p.m. EDT" (R5); "6:30 p.m. ET" (R6, R7); "starting at 6:30 p.m. Friday" (R8)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state coverage begins at 6:30 p.m. ET/EDT.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II splashdown is scheduled for approximately 8:07 p.m. EDT.

verifications.evidence: "8:07 p.m. Eastern time" (R1); "8:07 p.m. ET" (R2); "8:07 p.m. EDT" (R4); "approximately 8:07 p.m. EDT" (R5); "around 8:07 p.m. ET" (R6, R7)
verifications.reasoning: Exact time matches across sources.
